gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each 4-channel camera costs with the hardwire kit its parking mode needs: read 2026-11-21, the Vantrue N5S goes from $293.99 to $323.98 (over budget), while Rexing's bundle at $259.99 and the R4-RD at $279.99 include the kit, and the REDTIGER VisionPano 40 is $199.49 (not the $209.99 ChatGPT showed), or $235.48 with REDTIGER's kit.
standout_why: Compared against our own page (dealectric.com/best-4-channel-dash-cam), dashlore.com, dattatecblog.com, techsmagazine.com and the rexing.com R4-RD listing. Our page says per model whether a kit is included but gives no kit price or total, has no price for the Botslab G980H, and does not carry the VisionPano 40 that ChatGPT named in both chats. Dashlore lists only the N5S at $293.99 with 'hardwire kit sold separately' and no kit price. Dattatecblog names one 4-channel model (Icesky S03) with no price and says a kit 'adds about $15'. Techsmagazine names two sub-$90 no-name 4-channel cams with kits sold separately and no total. Tom's Guide came back truncated, so its picks were not compared. Scored 2 rather than 3 because rivals already say 'kit sold separately', and I could not open Botslab's or REDTIGER's product pages today (HTTP 429) to complete those two rows.
decides: On an under-$300 page the N5S qualifies only as a camera-only buy: with a Vantrue kit that names it, it is $323.98, so it stays the cabin/rideshare pick only for shoppers who skip parking mode. For front, rear, left and right with parking mode, the rows that stay under $300 are Rexing's bundle at $259.99 (kit, GPS and 64 GB card included), the R4-RD at $279.99 (kit included) and the R4 at $289.98 with the $29.99 kit; none of these is ours. Our Botslab G980H ($192.70 through our link) is the lowest-priced row read with a 3K front, but its all-in parking total is not established because Botslab's kit price could not be read. The Vantrue Nexus 5 ($265.99, awin:vantrue, no record yet) is the Vantrue 4-channel that stays under $300 with a kit ($295.98) and could be added as a row once its specs are read. The VisionPano 40 should be added as a rival row at $199.49. The Rexing R4 Pro at $319.99 is the model left out for being just over the line.
